title: I built a Gold EA with 9 strategies — here is the honest part before you try it
author: Due_Cauliflower1453
selftext:
have been working on Sycz HolyGrail for quite a while. It is an MT5 Expert Advisor made specifically for Gold on the H1 timeframe.

The EA combines nine independent strategies. The selected profile decides how many strategies are active, while position sizing adjusts according to the account balance and chosen drawdown level. It also includes news protection, configurable account limits and a dashboard showing the performance of each strategy separately.

Now for the important part: despite the name, this is not a magical “holy grail.” There is no trading system that can guarantee profits or completely avoid losses.

Sycz HolyGrail does not use grid or martingale, but it can still experience drawdown, losing streaks and periods where performance is slower. I consider it the best EA I have developed so far, but it needs to be used with realistic expectations.

It is also not a high-frequency day-trading robot. When Gold is moving slowly or none of the strategies finds a suitable setup, the EA may place only a few trades. That is intentional. I prefer having it wait instead of forcing entries just to increase the trade count.

If you purchased it—or received it during the free promotion—give it enough time to work through different market conditions. Do not judge it from one day or a handful of trades. Monitor the results and compare its behaviour with the official live signal.
